knobs.note: Spend guard: a run whose marker ts (state/restore-drill-last.json) is newer than this many hours exits 0 without buying a box, unless run with --force. 0 turns the guard off. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
How long the drill waits for the borrowed Orgo computer to report running before it FAILs (and deletes it). Wall time, not a poll count. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
Seconds between GET /computers/<id> polls while waiting for running. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
RAM of the borrowed Orgo computer. A 403 RAM_ADDON answer to this size is a SKIP, not a FAIL. A non-integer FAILs the run before any call. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
CPUs of the borrowed Orgo computer. A non-integer FAILs the run before any call. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
curl -m on every Orgo API call the drill makes, so no single call can hang the lane. Read by bin/lib/restore-drill-orgo.sh.
The project the post-restore smoke checks; exported to drill_on_box, whose steps (#1732) use it. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.

The Orgo template the borrowed computer is created from. No default: an Orgo template ref you own. Unset = the drill SKIPs as not configured and spends nothing. An identity of what gets booted, so not settable from a page. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
Path on the hub to the identity that decrypts the restored env; exported to drill_on_box, whose steps (#1732) use it. No default. A path, so not settable. Read by bin/restore-drill.sh.
The Orgo API host the drill calls with ORGO_API_KEY. A host, so not settable. Read by bin/lib/restore-drill-orgo.sh.
